q: The quantum mutual information for a bipartite state ρ_{AB} is defined as I(A:B)_ρ = S(A) + S(B) − S(AB). For a pure state |ψ⟩_{AB}, this equals:
exp: For pure |ψ⟩_{AB}: S(AB)=0 and S(A)=S(B) (by Schmidt decomposition), so I(A:B) = S(A)+S(B)−0 = 2S(A). This is twice the entanglement entropy and the maximum possible quantum mutual information for fixed marginals.
